mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS declines but S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate cooling real estate demand that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Both RSAFS and HOUST decline but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing contraction (INDPRO < 100) intensifies supply chain disruptions, increasing input costs and reducing corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 100 but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer spending index (RSAFS) indicates strong household demand that boosts corporate revenues and stock valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS rises but S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Both PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or interaction effect p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO annual growth < 0.5%) intensifies supply chain bottlenecks, increasing production costs and reducing profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO annual growth < 0.5% but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year windows.
